timer_seconds 72000 (D57): the PICKUP's gate, not Brighteyes's: quest row TuskFemalePickUp (id 5057) min_Delta 72000 s = 20 h, max_Solves -1; ACE refuses to pick this tusk from a corpse that is not the player's own while the quest cannot be solved again (Player_Inventory.cs:1249-1262; HandleSolveError QuestManager.cs:558-578), so one Female Tusker Tusk per 20 hours; a completion is recorded at the turn-in, so the next due time is never early
level: min 1 and max null are the ground tusker-burrow's entry portal 22663 MinLevel (none, so 1) and MaxLevel (none) (weenie_properties_int types 86 and 87; the profile's entry block)
experience: fixed 100,000 (the AwardXP amount_64 of emote 48423), not level-proportional

hunt-until: the carrier 22589 Female Tusker is on the tusker-burrow profile's targets; the item is the tusk 22423 (one per kill, a guaranteed Contain row); the step's count 1 is checked before the hunt, so a tusk already held skips it (the autopilot's errand runs this same file)

The Aphus Lassel Portal Gem 22729 that Brighteyes gives is the rung change's fallback (item 4's travel file gems, 'aphus-lassel': spell 2936 'Entrance to Tusker Island', arriving at the Refuge 0xF6820033): the turn-in's reward is also the way back to the Refuge, and item 4's travel file names this item as its source
